created_by: FI-008 (kimi-code) on external audit relay via Arif (F13 sovereign)
purpose: Read-only evidence registry of real Sabah well outcomes. Failure class addressed (external audit 2026-10-13): LLM outputs fabricated well outcomes — Tepat-1 labelled 'DRY / stratigraphic test' (it is a published oil & gas discovery) and exercise placeholder Wells A/B/D were given invented outcomes. Models and MCP tools MUST read outcomes from this registry, never generate them.
write_authority: Human-approved registration only. No tool, model, or LLM may mint, alter, or infer an outcome. Outcome changes require a provenance-logged human action — never auto-'ratified' or auto-'sealed'.

rules.placeholder_rule: status == 'placeholder' REQUIRES outcome == null. Any section/profile/rendering that attaches an outcome to a placeholder well fails validation and MUST return isError: true.

evidence_tiers.T4: inference — MUST NOT set outcome; status stays 'unknown'

rules.min_tier_for_outcome: T3 (outcome text must carry its tier; T1 preferred)
rules.conflict_rule: When sources disagree (e.g. discovery year 2017 vs 2018), record both with tiers; the higher tier wins and the conflict stays visible — never average, never silently pick.
